summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a parallel batch upload pipeline PR, then merge and perform comprehensive documentation updates across the project including DEFERRED.md audit, FEATURES.md update, README refresh, and a new filesystem specification doc.
summary.outcome: PR #416 was merged after fixing worker postMessage error handling and a doc comment. A new docs branch (PR #419) was created with updated DEFERRED.md (thoroughly audited), FEATURES.md (new features + Phase 39 vault settings), README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md, FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md (new), and CLAUDE.md. Phases 38 and 39 were added to the roadmap.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the implemented error tracking and remote log shipping solution — not Sentry or Datadog.
Desktop FUSE components are intentionally not unit tested; they are covered by the Desktop E2E suite because unit testing would require mocking too much of the host OS.
vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the full schema baseline (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) never included them.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable retention is still deferred to Phase 39.

@cipherbox/crypto has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only in a single test file (vault-ipns.test.ts) to test IPNS key domain separation; this is a leftover from the restructuring phase and should be removed.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are the remaining deprecated web services to retire in Phase 38.
Linux FUSE is implemented under the same 'fuse' feature flag as macOS, giving it NFC normalization and case-sensitive lookups.
The database has 14 tables total; share_invites and file_versions tables were added in phases 28-37 and were missing from DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md.
Old 00-Preliminary-R&D/Documentation/ paths were moved to .planning/milestones/m0/ in the main merge pulled at the start of the docs session.
pin:secondaryFailed event is emitted in Phase 37 — batch upload secondary pin warning events are implemented.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection has been implemented since Phase 12.6 via per-file IPNS metadata.

code.finding: postMessage and getWorker calls can throw, leaking pending entries. Fixed with try/catch to clean up pending map on error.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding; updated to clarify actual per-file chunk memory behavior.
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural limitation requiring SDK contract change (accept File objects or read callback instead of Uint8Array). Deferred as out of scope.
Only file in @cipherbox/crypto that imports @cipherbox/core, creating the cross-package devDependency. Could be refactored to use hardcoded test vectors instead.

workflow: When asked to audit a list for stale items, do a full systematic pass — not just the items the user calls out. Shallow passes require multiple correction rounds.
Resolving GitHub review threads requires two steps: REST API reply (using --field not -f for integer in_reply_to) then GraphQL mutation to mark resolved.
Integration tests requiring a live backend will always show as failures in local test runs; confirm they are pre-existing before treating as blockers.
Distinguishing operator config (env vars) from user-facing settings is important for deferred item accuracy — they address different problems.
The DTS circular dependency between crypto and core is test-only and was missed in the initial code quality audit pass; always check devDependencies separately from production deps.

friction: Initial DEFERRED.md audit was too shallow — multiple follow-up rounds were needed to catch items that were already implemented, never in scope (session replay), or premature (production Kubo hardening).
File editing tool reformatted markdown table widths, requiring a re-read of the actual file content before subsequent edits could match exactly.
Push failed on first attempt for the docs branch, requiring a retry.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS was initially (incorrectly) marked as implemented before recognizing it was operator config vs user-configurable setting — required an additional correction commit.
Linux FUSE support was missing from multiple docs (FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) and required several targeted edits across files.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts and bin.service.ts (migrate 9 importers to SDK methods, extract 2 used bin functions, remove @cipherbox/crypto devDependency on @cipherbox/core by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts to use hardcoded test vectors).
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period, soft vs hard delete toggle, max versions per file, version cooldown period.
Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts (reading all files to memory before SDK call) — requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array.
Sharing: link expiry enforcement, revocation propagation delay across nodes, and share invite email notifications are still deferred.
Upload pipeline: retry/resume for failed chunks on poor connections, and upload queue persistence across page reloads.
Desktop: auto-update mechanism for the desktop app.
Security: formal third-party security audit has not been scheduled.
